A row nested directly inside a cell keeps its visible text

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<table><tr><td><tr><td>Visible text</td></tr></td></tr></table>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
